title: Fear and Desire
plotSummary: Four soldiers whose plane has crashed behind enemy lines in an unnamed war try to reach their own side by building a raft. On the way, they capture a young woman, and one of them becomes obsessed with killing an enemy general in a nearby outpost.

title: Killer's Kiss
plotSummary: Washed-up boxer Davy Gordon rescues his neighbour, dance-hall girl Gloria, from her violent employer, and the two plan to leave New York together. The boss's thugs pursue them, ending in a fight among mannequins in a warehouse.

title: The Killing
plotSummary: Just out of prison, Johnny Clay assembles a crew to rob a racetrack of $2 million during a race. The heist is told in overlapping timelines, and it falls apart when one man's scheming wife tells her lover about the plan.

title: Paths of Glory
plotSummary: In France in 1916, Colonel Dax leads his regiment in a suicidal attack ordered by an ambitious general. When the attack fails, three soldiers are picked to be court-martialled and shot for cowardice, and Dax defends them.

title: Spartacus
plotSummary: Spartacus, a Thracian slave trained as a gladiator, leads a revolt that grows into an army of escaped slaves marching across Italy. In Rome, the general Crassus uses the uprising to seize power.

title: Lolita
plotSummary: Professor Humbert Humbert marries the widow Charlotte Haze to be near her teenage daughter Lolita, with whom he is obsessed. After Charlotte's death, he takes Lolita on a road trip across America, shadowed by the mysterious Clare Quilty.

title: A Clockwork Orange
plotSummary: In a near-future Britain, Alex leads a gang of droogs on nights of rape and "ultra-violence". Jailed for murder, he volunteers for the Ludovico technique, an aversion therapy that makes him sick at the thought of violence, and is released defenceless into the world.

title: Full Metal Jacket
plotSummary: Marine recruits endure basic training under a brutal drill instructor, ending in tragedy. The second half follows Private Joker, now a military journalist, through the Tet Offensive and the battle for Huế.

title: Eyes Wide Shut
plotSummary: After his wife Alice confesses a sexual fantasy about another man, New York doctor Bill Harford sets out on a night-long odyssey through the city. It leads him to a masked orgy at a country mansion, and to warnings that he has seen more than he should.

title: Day of the Fight
plotSummary: Kubrick's first film, a newsreel documentary following middleweight boxer Walter Cartier through the day of a bout, from breakfast and early Mass to the evening bout in Newark, New Jersey, which he wins.

title: Flying Padre
plotSummary: A documentary about Father Fred Stadtmueller, a priest who flies a light aircraft between the parishes of a vast district of New Mexico, saying a funeral Mass and flying a sick child and his mother to hospital.

title: The Seafarers
plotSummary: A promotional film for the Seafarers International Union showing the facilities and benefits it offers merchant seamen. It was Kubrick's first film in colour.
